text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hey there, I'm Fuji Kiseki.
Nice to meet you, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As an entertainer,
someday I want to show everyone the greatest "miracle"—
one worthy of my name!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Of course, to you as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
